purpose: Extend seasonal surcharge override-vs-standard resolution (already live on the headless/API pricing path via CalculationProcedureVersion v10 of Master_Media_Pricing_Procedure) to the Quote-UI OmniProcess path ('Opportunity with multiple Accounts' / MultipleAccounts), so AC6 (surcharge applies consistently regardless of entry point) is satisfied. v10 was confirmed to already implement the override logic correctly via live end-to-end testing against 5 scenarios on the headless Flow (SL_8451_Salesforce_Pricing_Endpoint); no CalculationProcedure/ExpressionSet change was needed or made. This manifest covers only the new Quote-UI-side Apex component.

components.name: SL_SeasonalSurchargeResolver
components.description: System.Callable Remote Action class (pattern follows existing SL_AccessToken precedent). Invokes the existing SL_8451_Salesforce_Pricing_Endpoint Flow (Flow.Interview.createInterview) once per quote line passed in, and returns the ret_Seasonal* and related pricing outputs for the OmniProcess to map onto QuoteLineItem fields (SL_Seasonal_Amount__c, SL_Seasonal_Percentage__c, SL_Seasonal_Override_Percentage__c, SL_Seasonal_Override_Rate_Id__c, SL_Seasonal_Surcharge_Plan_Id__c, SL_Seasonal_Surcharge_Source__c). Enforces a documented per-call line cap (40) as a bulkification guard since each line invokes a full Flow interview with its own SOQL/DML inside the pricing procedure.

components.name: SL_SeasonalSurchargeResolverTest
components.description: Unit tests for SL_SeasonalSurchargeResolver: empty/null input, missing-required-field negative paths (captured as a per-line failure, not a thrown exception, so one bad line never blocks the rest of the batch), mixed valid/invalid batch, bulk behavior at the documented 40-line cap, over-cap negative test, and System.Callable call()/invokeMethod() dispatch contract (success and unsupported-action paths). Does not re-verify the underlying pricing procedure's seasonal-surcharge math itself (CalculationProcedureVersion v10) - that was independently verified live against real MCDEV8451 data across 5 scenarios; these tests verify only what this class itself is responsible for: input validation, error isolation per line, the bulk guard, and the Remote Action dispatch contract.
